what: Bean-grain decorations and the inside of photo slots shift up and down by (distance between screen center and own center) × speed (default .2, halved below 768px), giving a parallax that misaligns more the farther from center — measured at the already-shifted position, so the actual shift converges to distance × speed/(1 + speed) (same as the original). No curve, tied directly to scroll

options.speed: Speed (multiplier on distance, negative reverses), default .2 — inside the brand photo frame .15~.2, bean decorations .05~.3
options.sp: Speed at widths of bp or less, default half of speed
options.max: Push upper limit (px), default none — Brand band photo 15 · booking band 10
options.scale: Scale to apply together, default none — enlarged so the cell edge never shows even when pushed (cell is overflow hidden) · Brand 1.1
options.lerp: Each scroll signal moves only this fraction of the remaining distance (0~1), default 1 (instant) — when scrolling stops it keeps easing and settles in place · brand .08
options.at: Reference line — screen height ratio, default .5 (center). One variant uses 0 (top edge of the screen)
options.self: Which height of the element is measured: ratio of its own height, default .5 (center). brand uses −.5 (half a height above the top edge)
options.span: When on, Rellax(center: true) style — subtract the pushed offset and measure in place: (own anchor point − screen baseline) × speed × 100 ÷ (own height + screen height) px (rounded). Over one pass through the screen everything moves speed × 100px in total, and a positive value rises faster than the scroll (opposite sign to the brand style). Like Rellax, the same speed at every width gives the same sp value

from.where: shared.js TK.parallax · every page .js-parallax (bean decoration·inside photo cells — original function.js setParallax: data-speed default .2, on phone (≤768) halved if there is no data-speed-sp, translateY((innerHeight/2 − (rect.top + rect.height/2)) × speed), on every Lenis scroll)

index.html .hm-intro__wide band photo · shared booking band photo — original appended code: pushes the 1.1× photo by (photo center − screen center) × .05 (±15px · booking band ±10px), but approaches only 8% per scroll signal with a transform .1s linear transition. speed: -0.05; sp: -0.05; max: 15; scale: 1.1; lerp: 0.08

index.html Product five mountain layers·Town three photos — original Parallax: translateY((top − height/2)/(screen/2) × screen × depth), depth per layer .0125·moon .025·cloud .075·mountains .1·.175, photos .015·.025·.035 (.025 at 599 and below). at: 0; self: -0.5; speed: −2×depth; Same value as sp. The original also measures at the already-shifted position

index.html .mk-rellax (cut-out photos and section text .2, wordmark, flowing band and place list .5) — original top.js Rellax(".rellax-top, .rellax-about, .rellax-movie, .rellax-contact", { center: true, breakpoints: [576,768,1201] }). The site uses the same rellax@1.12.1, and as parts, span: on; speed: .2; sp: .2
